note: Gujjar Home Class versions. kid / par = homeclass-kid.html KID_VER / homeclass.html PAR_VER, kidApk / parApk = APK versionCode. Every open page checks this every minute and updates itself. Add a news line (k kid|par|all, v = the new version of that kind) with every change, newest first.

news.t: 👋 After linking, the kids phone asks once who learns on it - pick your name or add a new child, fill in the class and birthday, Save - all set. This phone then rings for that child's class.
✏️ Children's details moved to ⚙️ Settings - the home page shows only the class.

✏️ My details on the kids phone: name, class, 🎂 birthday and how the app says the name (🔊 Hear it) - with a Save button; Mom and Dad see it too. ⏸ Parents can turn all classes off with one tap. Answers are hands-free by default.
✨ Neater screens: the kids app top bar fits one line (family name and date under the title), and the device buttons in the parent app sit under the device details.
🔄 A refresh button (top bar) in both apps loads the newest version at once. ➕ Adding a child now works on every phone. The voice says "zaa" by default.
👨‍👩‍👧 Other families can use Home Class: start a new family with your family name, ➕ add your children, and 🆘 Report a problem (note + voice note) from Settings. Choose if voice clips may be saved.
🆘 Report a problem (top right): write or record what went wrong - it reaches the Home Class team with the log. The app now shows your family name.
🩺 The TV's log no longer fills up with mic lines, so problems can still be checked later in the day.

📺 TV: everything fits the TV screen now (nothing under the buttons, keys not cut off). The remote's mic falls asleep when no button is pressed - the TV now says "Press OK on the remote" and OK turns the mic on. Spelling on the TV shows the letters popping up like the phone. Any remote button closes the update message.

📺 App h28 on the TV: the mic sign now uses the REAL sound from the remote (green = sound is coming in, red = nothing), and when the remote's mic goes quiet the app opens it again by itself. The spelling texts no longer sit on top of each other, and the TV keyboard opens only when you select the box.

📺 TV: the mic sign turns red (🔇 Mic OFF - press 🎤 Mic on) a few seconds after the remote's mic goes quiet - it said Mic ON while it was off. The table numbers on Practise a table are back to their old size.

📺 TV: every button now gets a gold ring when the remote is on it (Start class, the table numbers, the practice choices), so OK presses what you see. A big sign at the top shows 🎤 Mic ON - speak now (green) or 🔇 Mic OFF - press 🎤 Mic on (red).
📺 TV: the microphone now switches off when a question is answered, the class ends or the app is closed (it kept clicking on and off after the class).

⏭ Skipped questions no longer count - skipping a table never gives "learnt" or stars. 📺 TV: a 🎤 Mic on button wakes the remote's mic at once. ✏️ The spelling word shows in BIG CAPITALS, highlighted. ⏱️ Lessons and spelling get the same answer time + countdown as the tables (TV too).

📺 TV: the number keys now sit to the right of the table (they covered Skip / Pause / Stop). The TV tests a table with questions (its remote mic cannot hear a long recitation). If the app hears fewer than half the lines of a table, it asks for the whole table again - it never says "well done" for a table you did not finish.

📺 TV: saying a whole table now works - the big ▶ Start saying / ■ Done button is reached and pressed with the remote (it opens already selected), and the wrong "needs the new listening" message is gone.
📺 TV: the remote's microphone now stays open for the whole question (it used to switch off and on every few seconds, and words said in the gap were lost).
📺 The TV now runs the class itself: OK on a child starts the class here (tables and lessons like Evs), the same as on the phone - no kids phone needed.

✅ A wrong number is no longer taken as right: he said "twenty one" for 9 × 3 and the app heard "twenty seven" (it only listened for the right answer and its neighbours). It now listens for any number 1-100.
📺 TV: the class screen now fits the TV, so ⏭ Skip, ⏭ Skip warm-up, 🙈 Test me now, ⏭ Next table, 🔢 Go to table, ⏸ Pause and ⏹ Stop show at the bottom (they were cut off). Use the remote arrows and OK.

✅ The word on the card now matches the voice (it said "Excellent" and the card "Correct"). In the 5-question check, a line that was wrong but came back and was said right now counts: the table is learnt (it asked for the whole table again).

🎤 If you say "seven two ja" and stop, the app now waits quietly and the screen says "Now say the answer" (it no longer talks over you). The log also records how you spoke, to help us find why some answers are not heard.
🗣️ Saying a whole table: lines the app did not catch are no longer asked one by one. They go into the short check (5 questions) after the table, where the listening is much better.

✅ Saying a whole table: lines the app is unsure about now count as right - no more "say that line again". Then a short check of at most 5 random questions (the unsure lines first, never 1 and 10); all right = table learnt + stars.

🙈 When a question comes again after a wrong answer, the answer is now hidden on the table board (he has to remember it, not read it). If the app hears "seven two ja" but loses the answer, it says "Just say the answer."
🔊 App h27: the voice now uses Google's speech engine by name (the Motorola phone's own default engine said nothing). Settings shows which voice is in use.
🗣️ The question now sounds like "seven, seven zaa ..." (it was read as "seven seven how much").
🔇 If the phone's voice does not speak, a help bar now appears (open the phone's voice settings / try again). App h26 restarts a voice engine that does not start.
📱 Each phone gets a name (asked once) and shows its make and model. In the parent app you choose which phone a call goes to, and each child has a class phone that rings at class time.
⏱️ Settings: time to answer a question (Off / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30 s) and the countdown in the last 3 / 5 / 10 s.

⏱️ Answer countdown in the last seconds (set in the parent app). ✏️ Letters pop up one by one as the app spells the word. ⌨️ The Type / Speak button no longer gets stuck. Doubtful big-number answers are asked again.
🔊 "Hear it" (name and ja / za) now plays on THIS phone with its own voice - nothing goes to the kids phone.
🗣️ Settings: choose the word the voice says between the line and the answer (ja / za / jha / jaa / zaa / is) and 🔊 hear it on the kids phone.
🗣️ Tables with big numbers are now said properly: "twenty one, three ja" (not "two one three"). Every number the voice says is spoken as words.
🔊 "Hear it" now plays the name on the kids phone (this phone has no voice). Typing the name itself in "How to say the name" keeps the built-in "Aar yun".
🗣️ The voice now says "Aryan" properly (Aar yun). In the parent app: Settings → child → "How to say the name" + 🔊 Hear it, to change how any name is said.
🔢 "One seventy" now counts as 170 (and two forty = 240). A doubtful answer (70 for 170) is asked once more instead of "Not quite". ✏️ Long words get more time between letters and more forgiveness.
✨ The first line of a table ("5 one ja 5") is only said - the app no longer waits for it or asks again. If a line cannot be heard while learning, it goes on after 2 tries.

✏️ Spelling finishes by itself about a second after the last correct letter - no need to press Done. 🏠 Each child's block now holds all their buttons: Start class, Practise a table and their lessons (Evs).

⏭ Buttons now show only where they belong: Skip warm-up, 🙈 Test me now (while learning a table), Skip word (spelling). The screen no longer keeps the old question or word while the app talks about what comes next.

⏭ Skip button during the whole class (cuts the app's voice, skips a question), ⏭ Next table and 🔢 Go to table. If the app cannot hear twice, it says sorry and asks - no more repeating. Tables are never marked wrong from the long recitation, and a heard answer finds its line (3×8 = 24).
🛠️ Fixed: a new class could get stuck on "Welcome" if started right after another. Tables said right but heard slightly wrong (e.g. 3 as "thirty three") are asked again, never marked wrong.
✏️ Spelling: the word now pops up exactly when the app says it back ("bones is spelt B, O, N, E, S") and stays until it finishes. In Mom / Dad mode the letters show as you spell.
✏️ Spelling: you can now see what the app reads - each letter pops up as you say it (green = right, amber = sounds alike, red = different), and the word pops up big with "I heard" when you finish.
✏️ Spelling: while you spell, the screen now shows only the letters that fit the word (dots for the rest) - no more strange letters like "E S" for S.

✏️ Spelling: ⏭ Skip button (or say "skip"); Mom / Dad mode now finds the word from the letters; M, N, S and other letters are followed better. If the app is not sure it asks again - it never says "Not quite" on a doubtful hearing.
✏️ Spelling: N ("en") and other letters are followed much better - tested on Vihaan's own recordings. If the app is not sure, it asks again and never says "Not quite".
✏️ Spelling hears letters much better (tested on Vihaan's own recordings): "b o n e s" now comes out right even with talking around.
✏️ Spelling: other words the app hears (room talk, "yes") are ignored - only the letters count. New ⌫ Clear button to throw away what it heard and spell again.
✏️ Spellings: the app now hears letters properly (it was missing them), shows the letters live, and has 3 ways: 📖 show the words, 🙈 app says the word, 👨‍👩‍👦 Mom / Dad says any word.
📝 Each lesson is a separate class: ▶ Start it on 🏠 Home, give it its own time and days, or switch on 🔀 "Also after the tables" to mix it in.

📝 Lessons are their own classes now (▶ on Home, or their own time) - not mixed with the tables unless you switch on 🔀. Tables are said the parents' way: "1 eight ja 8". The app listens better for each answer (e.g. 12).
🗣️ Saying the table fast is followed better (tested on Vihaan's own voice). A line the app did not catch is asked alone - no whole table again. 📦 App h23 is only 6 MB; updates download on Wi-Fi.
🎙️ App h22: when you say a whole table, the sound is saved so we can make the listening understand you better.
📱 The table now fits the phone screen - no scrolling, on the 📖 table page and while saying the table.
🗣️ Saying the table fast works now: "5 one 5, 5 two 10 …" without "ja" is understood, and if you go back and say a line again, your latest one counts.
📚 Practise a table 4 ways: 📖 just show it (study alone), 🗣️ say it with the app, 👀 say it with the answers shown, 🙈 test without seeing - with ▶ Start saying / ■ Done.
🙈 Test a table from your phone: Home → the child's card → pick the table - the kids phone starts the test without seeing.
App h21: the app no longer closes at the first answer - the new offline listening now works on the phone.
📥 App updates show every step on screen: checking, downloading with a progress bar (% and MB), installing, done.
⟳ Check for update now checks the app too and shows both (screen and app version); the app asks again every 3 minutes until it has the newest one.
App h17: fixes the app closing by itself at the first answer; if the new listening engine ever fails, the phone switches to the old listening by itself.

🗣️ Say the whole table: Vihaan says the table non-stop (5 one ja 5, 5 two ja 10 ...), the app follows every line, tells him exactly which line was wrong or missed, practises it with him, then asks for the whole table once more.
🎤 New offline listening engine that only listens for table words - much better at fast speech, no internet needed (app h16).
🎤 Big answer button always at the bottom right (thumb): hold it while answering or tap once and speak. Press it any time - the app stops talking and listens.
✋ Hold to answer: press and hold the big button while answering, let go when done - only that is heard and it checks at once. (⚙️ → 🎙 Hands-free to switch back.)
Short answers understood even when Google writes a sound-alike ("the" for three, "to" for two, "ate" for eight).
🎤 Listens through pauses ("five ten… ja… fifty"), waits quietly until you start, and stray words are not marked wrong - it just listens again.
Each question comes only once per round. 🎤 When Google's internet listening fails, the phone's offline listening takes over.
🎤 A soft ding + "Your turn!" shows when to answer; a short pause no longer makes it talk; if Google is unsure (52 or 72?) it asks "Did you say 72? Say it again."
Fixed: after a quick answer the next question stopped listening by itself and the class ran on too fast ("Are you there?").
🩺 Each phone and the TV keep their own log for 24 hours: ⚙️ → 🩺 Log (shown only when you tap it, with 📋 Copy).
🎤 Listening fixed on Xiaomi phones: a fresh microphone listener for every answer, restarted by itself if it does not start.
🔊 "📱 Phone only (Google Home off)" is clearer, and the Google Home now plays the phone's own voice - if it does not start in 6 seconds, the phone speaks at once.
Fixed: a short answer like "eight" was shown but not taken ("Are you there?") - now it counts.
Google Home: if the speaker does not answer, the phone speaks at once instead of waiting.
📺 The TV can now ⏹ Stop the class that runs on the phone, and pressing ▶ twice no longer starts it twice.
Update messages close by themselves after 15 seconds (or tap them).
📺 TV practice: speak into the remote (the app opens the remote's microphone itself) - or type with the number keys, whichever is first.
Clearer app-update messages: what to press, and no repeated "downloading".
Fixed: 🏠 Home on the "Well done" screen now goes home at once.
Tables the way you say them: "two one ja two", "2 too ja four", "2 into 3 is 6" are understood now. One perfect round finishes a table.
📺 On the TV, ▶ starts the class on the kids phone (it listens) and the TV shows the big table board. ✍️ Practise with the remote is still there.
Settings: a table is finished after 1 perfect round (or choose 2).
App updates now install at once (only a running class waits) and the app opens again by itself or with one tap on "✅ updated".

🔊 Speaker page like the staff app: Auto / Always Google Home / Phone, speed 🐢 Slower to 🚀 Fastest, class volume, words on TV, Test and Stop. The Google Home is now made ready before the class, so the first sentence no longer waits.
Settings → Devices → 🔊: change a kids device's speaker, speed and volume from your phone.
🔊 New: speak on your Google Home over Wi-Fi - ⚙️ (top right) → 🔊 Speaker → 🏠 Google Home, pick it, done. No Bluetooth needed.
The device list shows which Google Home each kids device speaks on.
Fixed: the home screen could stop working after the first class (Back did nothing, ▶ Start from Mom / Dad's phone was not heard).
Reports read the table progress correctly.
🩺 Every device now keeps a short log (Settings → 🩺 Diagnostics, 📋 Copy) so problems can be found fast.
A phone or TV that was set up as a separate family joins the main family by itself.
▶ Start and 📣 Call from Mom's / Dad's phone now open the class even when the kids phone is locked or Home Class is in the background.
When the kids phone does not answer ▶ Start, the message now says exactly what to do.
Updates now arrive by themselves within a minute, and this card shows what changed.
Fixed: ➕ Add a device was stuck on "Making a code…"; a newly linked device shows at once.
Faster and steadier connection to the database.
Parent app for Android: speak to type and hear questions in the phone's own voice.
📋 Table board: the whole table on screen and on the TV, rows turn green as he answers, his words appear live.
